style: Avant-garde brass band, chamber ensemble, and theater-folk art-rock fusion. Harmony: dense quartal suspension fields with microtonal pure-interval friction and sliding subharmonic analog drones. Melody: angular cabaret patter with obsessive alveolar trills, front-rounded vowels, and volatile phrase-level prominence peaks. Rhythm: strict 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling, asymmetric 7/8 meter collisions, and destabilizing double-time hallucinations. Timbre: wavetable synthesis, bowed tagelharpa, darbouka, qanun, udu, djembe, balafon, and muted trumpet valves. Performance: breathless hype delivery paired with deep bewilderment headspace. Anchor: the persistent metric pulse surviving structural dropouts and micro-tonal phase drift. Acoustic decay modeling maps how everyday objects liquefy into auditory artifacts.
lyrics: [Intro] [Fast darbouka and udu pulse with raw ceramic clicks] [Wavetable synth drone sweeps upward] [Qanun arpeggios cascade in microtonal waves] Why do I lose everything all the time? [Tagelharpa bowed drone enters with sharp wooden friction] [Verse 1] [Breathless hype delivery, voice locked to an obsessive alveolar trill] The keys dissolved into the floorboards before I reached the lock, leaving only a dark chemical stain. [Djembe slap strikes on the off-beat] Every surface slips away like water through a sieve while I stand paralyzed in the emptying hall. [Qanun tremolo intensifies] I laid the map down flat, but the ink is fading backward into blank wood, erasing the roads I walked. [Balafon wood-bar cells answer in asymmetric 3:2 meter] The very lintels overhead evaporate when I look away for a single heartbeat, leaving the ceiling exposed to open sky. [Brass section enters with sliding microtonal glides] Why do I lose everything all the time while my hands remain permanently curved around empty air? [Chorus] [Choir enters in independent counterpoint lattice, staggering entries] [Subtractive filter cutoff sweeps downward as phrasing unfolds] The time is leaking out of the pockets of my winter coat onto the subway grates like spilled silver mercury! [Darbuka doum hits anchor the heavy pulse] We check the mahogany table twice, but the chairs have turned to rising smoke and ash that scatters in the draft! [Brass section stabs with microtonal beating overtones] Nothing stays put while the grandfather clock runs sideways through the corridor, devouring its own brass pendulum! [Verse 2] [Bewilderment headspace deepens, questions accumulate without resolution] Did I leave the hours on the porcelain kitchen counter beside the empty glass that is also slowly thinning into dust? [Udu air-bloom bass thuds] Or did the daylight pack its bags and catch an early train out of the valley while my back was turned? [Wavetable morph axis shifts timbre while pitch remains fixed] Every memory is an open window letting go of the room itself piece by fragile piece until the wallpaper peels into birds. [Tagelharpa bow scrapes louder against open-string drones] My shadow is detaching from my boots on the stairwell as the risers crumble into fine white powder. [Trumpet mutates into a dry rasp] Why do I lose everything all the time when I am holding on with every tendon in my failing arms? [Bridge] [Jurisdiction Dropout: Harmony jurisdiction temporarily deleted; only percussion and raw vocal phonetics survive] [Djembe edge and slap polyrhythms accelerate] [Phonetic percussion: hard consonants as transient spikes] T-t-t-t-t-time slips through the digital mesh of the nervous system! [Balafon high register answers udu sub bass] S-s-s-s-s-shift the paradigm of loss into perpetual subtraction! [Choir takes over rhythmic punctuation from instruments] [Anchor survival: compact vocal contour returns scarred but recognizable] Why do I lose everything all the time? [Climax] [Perpetual uplift: stacked choir layers expand register without final cadence] [Double-time hallucination in secondary percussion while base meter holds] The room is expanding while the plaster walls are shrinking inward to crush the floorboards into kindling! [Darbuka and djembe lock into furious 7/8 meter collision] We are catching at phantom shadows that were never even there in the first place, grasping at the spaces between atoms! [Qanun levers shift pitch resources upward in sudden bright bursts] [Outro] [Sudden drop to solo tagelharpa drone and dry udu tap] [Wavetable synth fades on a sustained unresolved suspension] Why do I lose everything all the time while the universe empties itself out behind my retreating footsteps? [Silence cuts abruptly on an unreleased spring resonance]
caption: An avant-garde art-rock and theater-folk composition governed by relentless 3:2 rhythmic coupling, microtonal quartal suspension fields, and obsessive vocal phonetic structures. The arrangement pits wavetable and subtractive synthesizers against traditional West African and Middle Eastern instruments including udu, darbouka, qanun, tagelharpa, and balafon.
